userStories.title: Redact known provider key formats
acceptanceCriteria: Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS, GitHub PAT, and JWT-shaped tokens are replaced with [REDACTED]
Each provider regex is covered by at least one unit test with a representative key
userStories.notes: praxis/redactor.py exposes redact_secrets(text) and PLACEHOLDER='[REDACTED]'. Patterns: _ANTHROPIC, _OPENAI, _AWS_ACCESS_KEY, _GITHUB_PAT, _JWT (composed in _PROVIDER_PATTERNS). Future stories should reuse PLACEHOLDER and extend _PROVIDER_PATTERNS rather than introducing a parallel constant.

userStories.title: Redact generic secret-like substrings
acceptanceCriteria: Any sequence of >= 20 alnum/`_`/`-` characters appearing after the literals key, token, secret, or password (case-insensitive) is replaced with [REDACTED]
Plain English text containing those words but no high-entropy tail is left unchanged
userStories.notes: _GENERIC_LABELED_SECRET regex: `(?i)(\b(?:key|token|secret|password)\b\W*)[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{20,}` with replacement `\1[REDACTED]` keeps the label and separator and redacts only the tail. _PROVIDER_PATTERNS was generalized to _PATTERNS as a tuple of (pattern, replacement) pairs so the labeled-secret entry can carry its own backref-using replacement and still run inside the single fold in redact_secrets().

userStories.title: Redaction is idempotent
acceptanceCriteria: Running the redactor twice on the same input produces the same output as one run
Already-redacted [REDACTED] markers are not duplicated or split
userStories.notes: No code change to praxis/redactor.py was needed. Idempotence falls out of three existing properties: (1) every value class excludes `[` so `[REDACTED]` can never start a match, (2) the labeled-secret rule requires >= 20 value-class chars after the label so the 8-char `REDACTED` body cannot satisfy the length, (3) the placeholder body `REDACTED` is not itself a label literal. Tests in tests/test_redactor.py (test_redact_is_idempotent_for_each_pattern, test_redact_is_idempotent_with_mixed_secrets_in_one_string, test_bare_placeholder_is_unchanged, test_placeholder_in_prose_is_unchanged, test_adjacent_placeholders_are_not_merged_or_split, test_placeholder_after_label_is_unchanged) lock these properties in. If a future story adds a pattern, it must keep `[` out of its value class and out of any tail-length budget.
